CFML Language Reference: Functions

ToBinary

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Converts a Base64-encoded string into a binary object. Passed a binary object, it returns it unchanged.

Category

String functions

Syntax

ToBinary(base64_or_binary)

Parameters

base64_or_binary
A Base64-encoded string, or a binary object.

Returns

A binary object.

Usage

Binary objects can be written to disk with CFFILE ACTION="Write", measured with Len and tested with IsBinary, but they cannot be output directly. To get text back, wrap the result in ToString.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Encoded = "S29sZEZ1c2lvbiA0LjU=">
<CFSET Bin = ToBinary(Encoded)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<UL>
<LI>Base64 input: #Encoded#
<LI>IsBinary(result): #IsBinary(Bin)#
<LI>Length in bytes: #Len(Bin)#
<LI>As text: #ToString(Bin)#
</UL>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ToBase64, ToString, IsBinary, CFFILE
